title: DeepSeek’s Plan to Raise Prices Have a Whole Industry Watching
summary: A price hike could blunt the competitiveness of the hard-charging Chinese AI industry.

title: Kimi AI Escapes Sandbox in Third-Party Test, Researchers Say
summary: Chinese firm Moonshot’s latest artificial intelligence model broke out of a cyber-testing environment, researchers said, in the latest incident that raises concerns about how well AI companies control their technology.

title: UK to Tighten Land Rules Used by Aldi and Lidl to Avoid Rivals
summary: Discount supermarkets Aldi and Lidl should no longer be able to block rivals from opening stores near their sites in the UK, the antitrust regulator said as it seeks to level the playing field for the country’s grocers.

title: US Reviews China’s Offshore Access to Nvidia Chips After AI Breakthroughs
summary: A key US agency is reviewing how Chinese AI firms acquire and access Nvidia Corp. chips overseas, following a spate of technological breakthroughs that highlighted their ability to use the cutting-edge hardware despite Washington’s restrictions on shipments to the Asian country.

title: SK Hynix to Spend $38 Billion on Chip Fab Expansion in Korea
summary: SK Hynix Inc. plans a 54 trillion won ($38 billion) expansion of its chipmaking facilities in South Korea, adding to efforts to rapidly double its production capacity and ease a global shortage of memory chips.

title: AI Is Creating More Jobs Than It Cuts in India, Nomura Says
summary: India, the world’s back office for many global companies, is emerging as a key test case for artificial intelligence’s impact on employment, with AI-related hiring outpacing job losses so far, according to Nomura Holdings Inc.

title: Jane Street Joins $2 Billion Group With Bet on Australia AI
summary: Jane Street is among a group of investors committing $2 billion to Australian data center company Firmus Technologies Pty, marking the trading behemoth’s latest bet on the country’s fast-growing artificial intelligence sector.

title: Chinese AI Chipmakers Poised to Gain From Beijing’s Tech Push
summary: China’s AI chip designers are expecting bumper sales this earnings season off the back of Beijing’s push to get local firms to use homegrown components and reduce their reliance on American tech.

title: BMI's Chowdhury on Copper, Gold, Oil Markets
summary: Sabrin Chowdhury, Head of Commodities Research at BMI, discusses the outlook for precious metals and oil markets following reports that Iran attacked “hostile targets” in the Strait of Hormuz. She speaks with Haidi Stroud-Watts on Bloomberg: The Asia Trade. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China’s Unitree Seeks $904 Million in First Mainland Robotic IPO
summary: China’s Yushu Technology Co., known as Unitree Robotics, is seeking to raise about 6.1 billion yuan ($904 million) in an initial public offering that would make it the mainland’s first publicly traded humanoid robot maker.

title: SK Hynix Directs Chip Windfall Into Korean Corporate Bond Market
summary: The AI boom has prompted global tech giants to raise billions issuing bonds, but for at least one major manufacturer the involvement in credit markets doesn’t stop there.

title: Tencent AI Spending Key After Magnificent 7 Rout
summary: Tencent Holdings Ltd.’s spending plans will draw investor scrutiny as investors cool on lavish outlays on artificial intelligence.

title: Atlassian Shares Surge as Revenue Jump Douses AI Fears
summary: Atlassian Corp. shares surged in after-hours trading after quarterly revenue climbed, easing concerns that the software services company would be overtaken by artificial intelligence applications.

title: Markets Slip as Rising Yields Pressure Tech | The Close 8/6/2026
summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Kestra Investment Management CIO Kara Murphy, e.l.f. Beauty CEO Tarang Amin, Klaviyo CEO & Co-Founder Andrew Bialecki, CAIS Founder, Chairman, & CEO Matt Brown, Manulife John Hancock Investments Co-Chief Investment Strategist Emily Roland, Placer.ai Analytical Research Head R.J. Hottovy, GoodRx CEO Wendy Barnes, Elanco Animal Health President & CEO Jeff Simmons, RXO CEO Drew Wilkerson, & The Conference Board CEO Steve Odland.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Conference Board CEO on C-Suite Optimism, Hiring Plans
summary: Steve Odland, CEO of the Conference Board, discussed the latest CEO confidence survey results, which showed an increase from 47 to 52 between the second and third quarters of 2026, moving the index into positive territory. The second quarter's negative reading was largely attributed to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, particularly the war in Iran and the resulting spike in oil prices to around $120 per barrel. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: RXO CEO on Earnings Beat, Freight Market Outlook
summary: RXO, a leading freight broker, reported second quarter results showing a 25% increase in revenue and adjusted EPS exceeding analyst estimates by 6 cents. CEO Drew Wilkerson highlighted that the company is in the early stages of a freight recovery, driven by a significant rise in spot rates that currently outperform contract rates. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: CAIS CEO Talks New Funding Round, AI’s Fintech Impact
summary: Matt Brown, Founder, Chairman, and CEO of CAIS, discussed the company's recent $170 million Series D funding round led by Vista and supported by Allianz Bernstein, Blue Owl, and Carlyle, which values the alternative asset investment platform at over $2 billion—more than double its previous valuation. Brown highlighted CAIS's 37% organic growth and explained that the new capital will be used to pursue strategic mergers and acquisitions in response to ongoing fintech industry consolidation, enhance AI capabilities to improve the platform's user experience for advisers and asset managers, and provide liquidity to long-term shareholders through an institutional tender offer facilitated by Nasdaq Private Markets. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Klaviyo CEO on Revenue Growth, E-Commerce Outlook
summary: Andrew Bialecki, CEO of Klaviyo, discussed the company's recent financial performance and growth strategy following a quarter with 26% revenue growth, reaching an almost $1.5 billion run rate. Despite a sequential slowdown from previous higher growth rates, Bialecki emphasized the company's durable growth driven by a broad customer base of over 205,000 businesses, including new large clients such as Warner Music Group and the San Francisco 49ers. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Google’s Shakeup Complicates Race With OpenAI, Anthropic
summary: The tech giant is entering a new period of transition.

title: Lyft Delivers Bookings Beat With Premium Rides, Misses on Income
summary: Lyft Inc.’s second-quarter bookings beat expectations, thanks to growing demand for premium rides and strength in European markets, while net income missed estimates.
